## Fig3C — prepare the ARG–MGE network tables

```{r prepare-Fig3C-network}
dir.create(file.path(REPO, "Fig3/output"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

library(readr)
library(dplyr)

args <- commandArgs(trailingOnly = FALSE)
file_arg <- grep("^--file=", args, value = TRUE)
script_dir <- file.path(REPO, "Fig3/output")


project_root <- REPO
output_root <- file.path(REPO, "Fig3/output/network")
main_dir <- file.path(output_root, "01_main_recommended")
expanded_dir <- file.path(output_root, "02_expanded_ge2_optional")
unfiltered_dir <- file.path(output_root, "03_all_pairs_unfiltered")
audit_dir <- file.path(output_root, "04_audit_and_repro")
audit_main_dir <- file.path(audit_dir, "01_main_mappings")
audit_expanded_dir <- file.path(audit_dir, "02_expanded_mappings")
audit_all_dir <- file.path(audit_dir, "03_all_pairs")
code_dir <- file.path(output_root, "05_code_and_docs")

for (path in c(
  main_dir, expanded_dir, unfiltered_dir, audit_dir, audit_main_dir,
  audit_expanded_dir, audit_all_dir, code_dir
)) {
  dir.create(path, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
}
s12_file <- file.path(REPO, "Fig3/data/ARG_MGE_annotations.tsv")
stopifnot(file.exists(s12_file))

main_arg_label <- function(x) {
  case_when(
    grepl("^TEM-", x) ~ "TEM-family",
    x == "Enterococcus faecalis chloramphenicol acetyltransferase" ~
      "CAT (E. faecalis)",
    x == "Enterococcus faecium chloramphenicol acetyltransferase" ~
      "CAT (E. faecium)",
    x == "AAC(6')-Ie-APH(2'')-Ia bifunctional protein" ~
      "AAC(6')-Ie-APH(2'')-Ia",
    TRUE ~ x
  )
}

unfiltered_arg_label <- function(x) {
  case_when(
    x == "Enterococcus faecalis chloramphenicol acetyltransferase" ~
      "CAT (E. faecalis)",
    x == "Enterococcus faecium chloramphenicol acetyltransferase" ~
      "CAT (E. faecium)",
    x == "AAC(6')-Ie-APH(2'')-Ia bifunctional protein" ~
      "AAC(6')-Ie-APH(2'')-Ia",
    TRUE ~ x
  )
}

normalize_mge_class <- function(x) {
  case_when(
    x == "Tn916" ~ "Tn916-like",
    x == "IS_or_transposase" ~ "IS/transposase",
    x == "IS" ~ "insertion sequence",
    x == "plasmid_related" ~ "plasmid-related",
    x == "transposon" ~ "transposon",
    x == "integron" ~ "integron",
    x == "qac_related" ~ "qac-related",
    x == "other_MGE" ~ "other MGE",
    TRUE ~ x
  )
}

arg_colour_name <- function(x) {
  case_when(
    x == "tetracycline" ~ "低饱和鼠尾草绿",
    x == "MLS" ~ "低饱和棕褐色",
    x == "aminoglycoside" ~ "柔和珊瑚红",
    x == "phenicol" ~ "低饱和蓝灰色",
    x == "multidrug" ~ "浅石板蓝灰色",
    x == "beta-lactam" ~ "低饱和灰紫色",
    x == "sulfonamide" ~ "柔和沙金色",
    x == "trimethoprim" ~ "低饱和卡其棕",
    x == "disinfecting agents and antiseptics" ~ "低饱和灰青色",
    x == "fluoroquinolone" ~ "淡薰衣草紫",
    x == "peptide" ~ "柔和杏橙色",
    TRUE ~ "中性灰色"
  )
}

mge_colour_name <- function(x) {
  case_when(
    x == "Tn916-like" ~ "砖红色",
    x == "IS/transposase" ~ "浅天蓝色",
    x == "insertion sequence" ~ "浅天蓝色",
    x == "plasmid-related" ~ "暖橙色",
    x == "qac-related" ~ "中等钢蓝色",
    x == "transposon" ~ "砖红色",
    x == "integron" ~ "深青蓝色",
    TRUE ~ "中等钢蓝色"
  )
}

make_mge_gene_label <- function(ids) {
  x <- sub("^[0-9]+_", "", ids)
  x <- sub("_[^_]+$", "", x)
  x <- gsub("_+$", "", x)
  x <- gsub("__+", "_", x)

  # Remove database-specific replicon-family prefixes while retaining the
  # biologically interpretable component or plasmid name.
  x <- sub("^[Rr]ep[A-Za-z0-9]+_[0-9]+_", "", x)
  x <- sub("^[Rr]epUS12_", "", x)

  case_when(
    x == "ColRNAI_1" ~ "ColRNAI-1",
    x == "repC(Cassette)" ~ "repC (cassette)",
    x == "rep(pUB110)" ~ "rep (pUB110)",
    x == "repB(pUB110)" ~ "repB (pUB110)",
    x == "rep(pKH7)" ~ "rep (pKH7)",
    x == "repE(pTEF1)" ~ "repE (pTEF1)",
    x == "ORF(E.faeciumContig1183)" ~ "ORF (E. faecium contig1183)",
    x == "rep(pKH21)" ~ "rep (pKH21)",
    x == "repC(pS0385-1)" ~ "repC (pS0385-1)",
    x == "ORF(pNE131)" ~ "ORF (pNE131)",
    x == "rep(pKH13)" ~ "rep (pKH13)",
    TRUE ~ x
  )
}

rep99_hits <- read_tsv(s12_file, show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  filter(genome_set == "Rep99", best_hit == "yes") |>
  mutate(
    ARG_display = main_arg_label(ARG_gene),
    ARG_display_unfiltered = unfiltered_arg_label(ARG_gene),
    MGE_element_id = best_hit_MGE_id,
    MGE_database_index = sub("_.*$", "", best_hit_MGE_id),
    MGE_gene_label = make_mge_gene_label(best_hit_MGE_id),
    MGE_class = normalize_mge_class(best_hit_MGE_category)
  )

stopifnot(nrow(rep99_hits) == 278L)
stopifnot(!any(is.na(rep99_hits$MGE_element_id)))
stopifnot(!any(rep99_hits$MGE_element_id == ""))

pair_summary <- rep99_hits |>
  group_by(
    ARG_display,
    ARG_class,
    MGE_gene_label,
    MGE_class
  ) |>
  summarise(
    ARG_gene_members = paste(sort(unique(ARG_gene)), collapse = ";"),
    MGE_element_ids = paste(sort(unique(MGE_element_id)), collapse = ";"),
    MGE_database_entry_count = n_distinct(MGE_element_id),
    legacy_MGE_categories = paste(
      sort(unique(best_hit_MGE_category)),
      collapse = ";"
    ),
    hit_count = n(),
    carrier_genome_count = n_distinct(genome_id),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  arrange(desc(hit_count), ARG_display, MGE_gene_label)

pair_summary_unfiltered <- rep99_hits |>
  group_by(
    ARG_display = ARG_display_unfiltered,
    ARG_class,
    MGE_gene_label,
    MGE_class
  ) |>
  summarise(
    ARG_gene_members = paste(sort(unique(ARG_gene)), collapse = ";"),
    MGE_element_ids = paste(sort(unique(MGE_element_id)), collapse = ";"),
    MGE_database_entry_count = n_distinct(MGE_element_id),
    legacy_MGE_categories = paste(
      sort(unique(best_hit_MGE_category)),
      collapse = ";"
    ),
    hit_count = n(),
    carrier_genome_count = n_distinct(genome_id),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  arrange(desc(hit_count), ARG_display, MGE_gene_label)

write_tsv(
  pair_summary,
  file.path(audit_dir, "Fig4C_specific_MGE_TEM_merged_pair_source_data.tsv")
)
write_tsv(
  pair_summary_unfiltered,
  file.path(audit_dir, "Fig4C_specific_MGE_unfiltered_pair_source_data.tsv")
)

build_chiplot <- function(
  selected_pairs,
  dataset_name,
  selection_rule,
  import_dir,
  mapping_dir
) {
  selected_pairs <- selected_pairs |>
    arrange(desc(hit_count), ARG_display, MGE_gene_label)

  arg_nodes <- selected_pairs |>
    group_by(ARG_display, ARG_class) |>
    summarise(
      ARG_gene_members = paste(
        sort(unique(unlist(strsplit(ARG_gene_members, ";", fixed = TRUE)))),
        collapse = ";"
      ),
      total_hits = sum(hit_count),
      degree = n(),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) |>
    arrange(desc(total_hits), ARG_display) |>
    mutate(
      id = sprintf("ARG_%03d", row_number()),
      label = ARG_display,
      node_type = "ARG",
      node_class = ARG_class,
      color_group = paste("ARG", ARG_class, sep = " | "),
      recommended_colour = arg_colour_name(ARG_class),
      MGE_gene_label = NA_character_,
      MGE_class = NA_character_,
      MGE_element_ids = NA_character_,
      MGE_database_entry_count = NA_integer_,
      legacy_MGE_categories = NA_character_
    )

  mge_nodes <- selected_pairs |>
    group_by(
      MGE_gene_label,
      MGE_class
    ) |>
    summarise(
      MGE_element_ids = paste(
        sort(unique(unlist(strsplit(MGE_element_ids, ";", fixed = TRUE)))),
        collapse = ";"
      ),
      MGE_database_entry_count = n_distinct(
        unlist(strsplit(MGE_element_ids, ";", fixed = TRUE))
      ),
      legacy_MGE_categories = paste(
        sort(unique(unlist(strsplit(
          legacy_MGE_categories,
          ";",
          fixed = TRUE
        )))),
        collapse = ";"
      ),
      total_hits = sum(hit_count),
      degree = n(),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) |>
    arrange(desc(total_hits), MGE_gene_label) |>
    mutate(
      id = sprintf("MGE_%03d", row_number()),
      label = MGE_gene_label,
      node_type = "MGE",
      node_class = MGE_class,
      color_group = paste("MGE", MGE_class, sep = " | "),
      recommended_colour = mge_colour_name(MGE_class),
      ARG_display = NA_character_,
      ARG_class = NA_character_,
      ARG_gene_members = NA_character_
    )

  node_mapping <- bind_rows(
    arg_nodes |>
      select(
        id, label, node_type, node_class, color_group, recommended_colour,
        ARG_display, ARG_class, ARG_gene_members,
        MGE_gene_label, MGE_class, MGE_element_ids,
        MGE_database_entry_count, legacy_MGE_categories,
        total_hits, degree
      ),
    mge_nodes |>
      select(
        id, label, node_type, node_class, color_group, recommended_colour,
        ARG_display, ARG_class, ARG_gene_members,
        MGE_gene_label, MGE_class, MGE_element_ids,
        MGE_database_entry_count, legacy_MGE_categories,
        total_hits, degree
      )
  )

  node_standard <- node_mapping |>
    select(id, label)

  node_coloring <- node_mapping |>
    select(
      id, label, node_type, node_class, color_group,
      recommended_colour, total_hits, degree
    )

  arg_id <- setNames(arg_nodes$id, arg_nodes$ARG_display)
  mge_node_key <- paste(
    mge_nodes$MGE_gene_label,
    mge_nodes$MGE_class,
    sep = "||"
  )
  mge_id <- setNames(mge_nodes$id, mge_node_key)

  edge_mapping <- selected_pairs |>
    mutate(
      id = sprintf("link_%03d", row_number()),
      source = unname(arg_id[ARG_display]),
      target = unname(mge_id[paste(MGE_gene_label, MGE_class, sep = "||")]),
      weight = hit_count,
      highlight_role = case_when(
        ARG_display == "tet(M)" &
          grepl("Tn916", MGE_gene_label, ignore.case = TRUE) ~
          "tet(M)-Tn916 component",
        ARG_display == "TEM-family" &
          MGE_gene_label == "ColRNAI-1" ~
          "TEM-family-ColRNAI-1",
        TRUE ~ "other"
      )
    ) |>
    select(
      id, source, target, weight,
      ARG_gene = ARG_display,
      ARG_gene_members,
      ARG_class,
      MGE_gene_label,
      MGE_class,
      MGE_element_ids,
      MGE_database_entry_count,
      legacy_MGE_categories,
      hit_count,
      carrier_genome_count,
      highlight_role
    )

  edge_unweighted <- edge_mapping |>
    select(id, source, target)

  edge_weighted <- edge_mapping |>
    select(id, source, target, weight)

  stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(node_standard$id))
  stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(edge_unweighted$id))
  stopifnot(all(edge_unweighted$source %in% node_standard$id))
  stopifnot(all(edge_unweighted$target %in% node_standard$id))
  stopifnot(sum(edge_mapping$weight) == sum(selected_pairs$hit_count))

  write_tsv(
    node_standard,
    file.path(import_dir, "Fig4C_node.tsv")
  )
  write_tsv(
    node_coloring,
    file.path(import_dir, "Fig4C_node_coloring.tsv")
  )
  write_tsv(
    edge_unweighted,
    file.path(mapping_dir, "Fig4C_edge_unweighted.tsv")
  )
  write_tsv(
    edge_weighted,
    file.path(import_dir, "Fig4C_edge_weighted.tsv")
  )
  write_tsv(
    node_mapping,
    file.path(mapping_dir, "Fig4C_node_mapping.tsv")
  )
  write_tsv(
    edge_mapping,
    file.path(mapping_dir, "Fig4C_edge_mapping.tsv")
  )

  tibble(
    dataset = dataset_name,
    selection_rule = selection_rule,
    ARG_nodes = nrow(arg_nodes),
    MGE_gene_or_component_nodes = nrow(mge_nodes),
    total_nodes = nrow(node_standard),
    edges = nrow(edge_mapping),
    represented_hits = sum(edge_mapping$weight),
    total_Rep99_MGE_associated_hits = nrow(rep99_hits),
    represented_fraction = sum(edge_mapping$weight) / nrow(rep99_hits)
  )
}

main_pairs <- pair_summary |>
  filter(hit_count >= 3)

expanded_pairs <- pair_summary |>
  filter(hit_count >= 2)

summary_tables <- bind_rows(
  build_chiplot(
    main_pairs,
    "main_recommended_ge3",
    "ARG-MGE gene/component pairs with hit_count >= 3; TEM alleles merged as TEM-family",
    main_dir,
    audit_main_dir
  ),
  build_chiplot(
    expanded_pairs,
    "expanded_optional_ge2",
    "ARG-MGE gene/component pairs with hit_count >= 2; TEM alleles merged as TEM-family",
    expanded_dir,
    audit_expanded_dir
  ),
  build_chiplot(
    pair_summary_unfiltered,
    "all_pairs_unfiltered",
    "All Rep99 ARG-MGE gene/component pairs; no frequency filter and no TEM-family merging",
    unfiltered_dir,
    audit_all_dir
  )
)

write_tsv(
  summary_tables,
  file.path(audit_dir, "Fig4C_specific_MGE_ChiPlot_dataset_summary.tsv")
)

main_edge_mapping <- read_tsv(
  file.path(audit_main_dir, "Fig4C_edge_mapping.tsv"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

readme <- c(
  "# Fig. 4C ChiPlot inputs at the MGE gene/component level",
  "",
  "## What changed",
  "",
  "MGE nodes represent the annotated MGE gene or component rather than individual database entries. Database indices and sequence accessions are removed from the displayed labels. For example, multiple accession-specific `tnpA` entries are combined into one `tnpA` node, whereas distinct Tn916 components remain separate nodes.",
  "",
  "Exact `best_hit_MGE_id` values remain in the audit mapping tables as `MGE_element_ids`. This preserves traceability after label simplification and aggregation.",
  "",
  "Each node is classified for colouring. ARG nodes use `ARG_class`; MGE nodes use the normalized `MGE_class`. The `recommended_colour` column gives the manuscript-consistent colour name, and `color_group` provides the corresponding grouping key in `Fig4C_node_coloring.tsv`.",
  "",
  "## Recommended main-figure files",
  "",
  "- `01_main_recommended/Fig4C_node.tsv`",
  "- `01_main_recommended/Fig4C_edge_weighted.tsv`",
  "- `01_main_recommended/Fig4C_node_coloring.tsv`",
  "- Use the weighted edge file when ChiPlot accepts a weight column; otherwise use the unweighted file.",
  "",
  "The recommended network retains recurrent ARG-MGE gene/component pairs with at least three Rep99 hits. TEM-1, TEM-116, TEM-171 and TEM-181 are combined as `TEM-family`, and the associated plasmid-related component is displayed as `ColRNAI-1`.",
  "",
  "## Alternative files",
  "",
  "- `02_expanded_ge2_optional`: pairs supported by at least two Rep99 hits.",
  "- `03_all_pairs_unfiltered`: every Rep99 ARG-specific MGE best-hit pair, without a frequency threshold or TEM-family merging.",
  "- `04_audit_and_repro`: mapping tables and source-data audit.",
  "",
  "## Data scope",
  "",
  "- Dataset: 4,808 Rep99 representative genomes.",
  "- Rep99 ARG hits: 1,424.",
  "- MGE-associated Rep99 ARG hits with a specific best hit: 278.",
  "- Each edge weight is the number of Rep99 ARG hits assigned to the corresponding ARG-MGE gene/component pair.",
  "",
  "## Important interpretation boundary",
  "",
  "The simplified MGE label is parsed from a best-hit database annotation and should not automatically be described as a complete mobile genetic element. The network represents recurrent ARG-MGE gene/component co-annotations within the defined ARG flanking window and does not prove horizontal transfer.",
  "",
  "## Suggested ChiPlot styling",
  "",
  "- ARG nodes: left side; colour by ARG class.",
  "- MGE nodes: right side; colour by MGE class.",
  "- Edge width: `weight`.",
  "- Highlight tet(M)-Tn916 component edges as the dominant signal.",
  "- Highlight the TEM-family-ColRNAI-1 edge as the secondary plasmid-related signal.",
  "- Use `Fig4C_node_coloring.tsv` to assign colours and retain exact IDs only in source-data and mapping tables.",
  "",
  "## Main-network audit",
  "",
  paste0("- Nodes: ", summary_tables$total_nodes[1], "."),
  paste0("- Edges: ", summary_tables$edges[1], "."),
  paste0(
    "- Represented hits: ", summary_tables$represented_hits[1], "/",
    summary_tables$total_Rep99_MGE_associated_hits[1], " (",
    round(100 * summary_tables$represented_fraction[1], 1), "%)."
  ),
  paste0(
    "- tet(M)-Tn916 component edges in the retained network: ",
    sum(main_edge_mapping$highlight_role == "tet(M)-Tn916 component"), "."
  ),
  paste0(
    "- TEM-family-ColRNAI-1 edge weight: ",
    main_edge_mapping |>
      filter(highlight_role == "TEM-family-ColRNAI-1") |>
      pull(weight), "."
  )
)
writeLines(
  readme,
  file.path(code_dir, "README_Fig4C_specific_MGE_ChiPlot.md"),
  useBytes = FALSE
)

cat("Specific-MGE ChiPlot files exported to: ", normalizePath(output_root), "\n", sep = "")
print(summary_tables)
```

## Fig3E — MGE evidence in single/multi-species clusters

```{r plot-Fig3E-cluster-MGE}
dir.create(file.path(REPO, "Fig3/output"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(scales)

args <- commandArgs(trailingOnly = FALSE)
file_arg <- grep("^--file=", args, value = TRUE)
script_dir <- file.path(REPO, "Fig3/output")

project_root <- REPO
cluster_file <- file.path(REPO, "Fig3/data/ARG99_cluster_spread_MGE_analysis_input.tsv")
stopifnot(file.exists(cluster_file))

clusters <- read_tsv(cluster_file, show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  mutate(
    species_group = if_else(
      species_count >= 2,
      "Multi-species\n(\u22652 species)",
      "Single-species\n(1 species)"
    ),
    species_group = factor(
      species_group,
      levels = c(
        "Single-species\n(1 species)",
        "Multi-species\n(\u22652 species)"
      )
    ),
    potentially_mobile = species_count >= 2
  )

summary_data <- clusters |>
  group_by(species_group) |>
  summarise(
    total_clusters = n(),
    MGE_positive = sum(has_MGE_evidence),
    MGE_negative = total_clusters - MGE_positive,
    MGE_positive_fraction = MGE_positive / total_clusters,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  rowwise() |>
  mutate(
    ci = list(binom.test(MGE_positive, total_clusters)$conf.int),
    ci_low = ci[[1]],
    ci_high = ci[[2]]
  ) |>
  ungroup() |>
  select(-ci)

single <- summary_data |> filter(grepl("^Single", as.character(species_group)))
multi <- summary_data |> filter(grepl("^Multi", as.character(species_group)))

fisher_table <- matrix(
  c(
    multi$MGE_positive, multi$MGE_negative,
    single$MGE_positive, single$MGE_negative
  ),
  nrow = 2,
  byrow = TRUE,
  dimnames = list(
    species_group = c("Multi-species", "Single-species"),
    MGE_status = c("MGE-positive", "No detected MGE")
  )
)
fisher_result <- fisher.test(fisher_table)

format_p <- function(x) {
  if (x < 0.001) {
    "<0.001"
  } else {
    formatC(x, format = "f", digits = 4)
  }
}

summary_data <- summary_data |>
  mutate(
    group_definition = if_else(
      grepl("^Multi", as.character(species_group)),
      "\u22652 carrier species; operationally classified as potentially mobile",
      "1 carrier species"
    ),
    MGE_positive_percent = 100 * MGE_positive_fraction,
    ci_low_percent = 100 * ci_low,
    ci_high_percent = 100 * ci_high,
    direct_label = paste0(
      MGE_positive, "/", total_clusters,
      "\n(", percent(MGE_positive_fraction, accuracy = 0.1), ")"
    ),
    fisher_odds_ratio_multi_vs_single = if_else(
      grepl("^Multi", as.character(species_group)),
      unname(fisher_result$estimate),
      NA_real_
    ),
    fisher_ci_low = if_else(
      grepl("^Multi", as.character(species_group)),
      fisher_result$conf.int[1],
      NA_real_
    ),
    fisher_ci_high = if_else(
      grepl("^Multi", as.character(species_group)),
      fisher_result$conf.int[2],
      NA_real_
    ),
    fisher_p_value = if_else(
      grepl("^Multi", as.character(species_group)),
      fisher_result$p.value,
      NA_real_
    )
  )

cluster_assignments <- clusters |>
  transmute(
    ARG99_cluster_id,
    representative_ARG_gene,
    species_count,
    species_group = gsub("\n", " ", as.character(species_group)),
    potentially_mobile,
    has_MGE_evidence,
    MGE_associated_hit_count,
    MGE_associated_rate,
    is_tetM
  )

write_tsv(
  summary_data |>
    mutate(
      species_group = gsub("\n", " ", as.character(species_group)),
      direct_label = gsub("\n", " ", direct_label)
    ),
```

## Fig3F — species-level carrier prevalence

```{python analyze-Fig3F-species-prevalence}

from pathlib import Path
import os
REPO = Path(os.environ["FIGURE_REPO_ROOT"])
(REPO / "Fig3/output").mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

from pathlib import Path

import matplotlib

matplotlib.use("Agg")

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from scipy.stats import fisher_exact
from statsmodels.stats.proportion import proportion_confint


plt.rcParams["font.family"] = "sans-serif"
plt.rcParams["font.sans-serif"] = ["Arial", "DejaVu Sans", "Liberation Sans"]
plt.rcParams["svg.fonttype"] = "none"
plt.rcParams["pdf.fonttype"] = 42
plt.rcParams["font.size"] = 7
plt.rcParams["axes.linewidth"] = 0.8
plt.rcParams["axes.spines.top"] = False
plt.rcParams["axes.spines.right"] = False
plt.rcParams["legend.frameon"] = False


MIN_REP99_GENOMES = 50
OUT_DIR = (REPO / 'Fig3/output')
PROJECT_DIR = REPO
REP99_FILE = (
    (REPO / 'Fig3/data/Rep99_genomes.tsv')
)
CLUSTER_DIR = (
    (REPO / 'Fig3/output')
)


def bh_adjust(p_values: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    order = np.argsort(p_values)
    ranked = p_values[order] * len(p_values) / (
        np.arange(len(p_values)) + 1
    )
    adjusted_ranked = np.minimum.accumulate(ranked[::-1])[::-1]
    adjusted = np.empty(len(p_values))
    adjusted[order] = np.minimum(adjusted_ranked, 1.0)
    return adjusted


def build_source_data() -> tuple[pd.DataFrame, float]:
    rep99 = pd.read_csv(REP99_FILE, sep="\t", dtype=str)
    members = pd.read_csv(
        (REPO / 'Fig3/data/ARG99_sequence_cluster_members.tsv'),
        sep="\t",
        dtype=str,
    )
    clusters = pd.read_csv(
        (REPO / 'Fig3/data/ARG99_sequence_cluster_summary.tsv'),
        sep="\t",
        dtype=str,
    )

    multi_species_clusters = set(
        clusters.loc[
            clusters["multi_species"].str.lower().eq("true"),
            "ARG99_cluster_id",
        ]
    )
    mobile_genomes = set(
        members.loc[
            members["ARG99_cluster_id"].isin(multi_species_clusters),
            "genome_id",
        ]
    )
    rep99["mobile_ARG_carrier"] = rep99["genome_id"].isin(mobile_genomes)

    total_mobile = int(rep99["mobile_ARG_carrier"].sum())
    total_genomes = len(rep99)
    overall_rate = total_mobile / total_genomes

    rows = []
    for species, group in rep99.groupby("species"):
        species_mask = rep99["species"].eq(species)
        carriers = int(group["mobile_ARG_carrier"].sum())
        total = len(group)
        noncarriers = total - carriers
        other_carriers = total_mobile - carriers
        other_noncarriers = (
            total_genomes - total_mobile - noncarriers
        )
        odds_ratio, p_value = fisher_exact(
            [
                [carriers, noncarriers],
                [other_carriers, other_noncarriers],
            ]
        )
        ci_low, ci_high = proportion_confint(
            carriers,
            total,
            method="beta",
        )
        rows.append(
            {
                "species": species,
                "total_Rep99_genomes": total,
                "mobile_ARG_carrier_genomes": carriers,
                "mobile_ARG_carrier_rate": carriers / total,
                "mobile_ARG_carrier_percent": 100 * carriers / total,
                "exact_95CI_low_percent": 100 * ci_low,
                "exact_95CI_high_percent": 100 * ci_high,
                "odds_ratio_vs_other_species": odds_ratio,
                "fisher_exact_p": p_value,
            }
        )

    results = pd.DataFrame(rows)
    results["BH_adjusted_p_all_species"] = bh_adjust(
        results["fisher_exact_p"].to_numpy()
    )
    results["significance_group"] = "Not significant"
    results.loc[
        (results["BH_adjusted_p_all_species"] < 0.05)
        & (results["odds_ratio_vs_other_species"] > 1),
        "significance_group",
    ] = "Enriched"
    results.loc[
        (results["BH_adjusted_p_all_species"] < 0.05)
        & (results["odds_ratio_vs_other_species"] < 1),
        "significance_group",
    ] = "Depleted"

    results["displayed"] = (
        results["total_Rep99_genomes"] >= MIN_REP99_GENOMES
    )
    return results, overall_rate


def abbreviate_species(species: str) -> str:
    return species


def plot(results: pd.DataFrame, overall_rate: float) -> None:
    data = results.loc[results["displayed"]].copy()
    data = data.sort_values(
        ["mobile_ARG_carrier_rate", "total_Rep99_genomes"],
        ascending=[True, True],
    ).reset_index(drop=True)

    colors = {
        "Enriched": "#B45F49",
        "Depleted": "#52748C",
        "Not significant": "#AEB3B6",
    }

    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(6.35, 5.55))
    y = np.arange(len(data))
    rates = data["mobile_ARG_carrier_percent"].to_numpy()
    low = data["exact_95CI_low_percent"].to_numpy()
    high = data["exact_95CI_high_percent"].to_numpy()

    for i, row in data.iterrows():
        color = colors[row["significance_group"]]
        ax.plot(
            [low[i], high[i]],
            [y[i], y[i]],
            color=color,
            linewidth=1.05,
            solid_capstyle="round",
            zorder=2,
        )
        ax.plot(
            rates[i],
            y[i],
            marker="o",
            markersize=4.6,
            markerfacecolor=color,
            markeredgecolor="white",
            markeredgewidth=0.45,
            linestyle="none",
            zorder=3,
        )

    ax.axvline(
        100 * overall_rate,
        color="#555555",
        linestyle=(0, (2.5, 2.5)),
        linewidth=0.8,
        zorder=1,
    )
    ax.text(
        100 * overall_rate + 0.6,
        len(data) - 0.45,
        f"Overall {100 * overall_rate:.1f}%",
        fontsize=6.1,
        color="#555555",
        va="top",
        ha="left",
    )

    labels = [abbreviate_species(x) for x in data["species"]]
    ax.set_yticks(y)
    ax.set_yticklabels(labels, fontsize=6.2, fontstyle="italic")

    ax.set_xlim(0, 82)
    ax.set_ylim(-0.65, len(data) - 0.2)
    ax.set_xticks(np.arange(0, 81, 10))
    ax.set_xlabel("Genomes carrying multi-species ARGs (%)")
    ax.grid(
        axis="x",
        color="#E5E5E5",
        linewidth=0.5,
        alpha=0.8,
        zorder=0,
    )
    ax.tick_params(axis="x", length=3, width=0.7, color="#555555")
    ax.tick_params(axis="y", length=0, pad=5)

    legend_handles = [
        plt.Line2D(
            [],
            [],
            marker="o",
            linestyle="none",
            markerfacecolor=colors[group],
            markeredgecolor="white",
            markeredgewidth=0.45,
            markersize=4.6,
            label=label,
        )
        for group, label in [
            ("Enriched", "Enriched"),
            ("Depleted", "Depleted"),
            ("Not significant", "Not significant"),
        ]
    ]
    ax.legend(
        handles=legend_handles,
        title="Fisher’s exact test\nBH-adjusted P < 0.05",
        loc="lower right",
        fontsize=6.0,
        title_fontsize=6.0,
        borderaxespad=0.35,
        handletextpad=0.4,
        labelspacing=0.35,
    )

    ax.text(
        0,
        -0.105,
        (
            f"Species represented by ≥{MIN_REP99_GENOMES} genomes are shown. "
            "Bars indicate exact binomial 95% confidence intervals; each species "
            "was compared with all other species."
        ),
        transform=ax.transAxes,
        fontsize=5.9,
        color="#666666",
        ha="left",
        va="top",
    )

    fig.subplots_adjust(left=0.43, right=0.98, bottom=0.16, top=0.98)
    base = (REPO / 'Fig3/output/species_mobile_ARG_carrier_prevalence')
    fig.savefig(base.with_suffix(".svg"), bbox_inches="tight")
    fig.savefig(base.with_suffix(".pdf"), bbox_inches="tight")
    fig.savefig(base.with_suffix(".png"), dpi=300, bbox_inches="tight")
    fig.savefig(base.with_suffix(".tiff"), dpi=600, bbox_inches="tight")
    plt.close(fig)


def main() -> None:
    results, overall_rate = build_source_data()
    results.to_csv(
        (REPO / 'Fig3/output/species_mobile_ARG_carrier_prevalence_source_data.tsv'),
        sep="\t",
        index=False,
    )
    plot(results, overall_rate)
    print(
        f"Displayed {(results['displayed']).sum()} species; "
        f"overall carrier rate={100 * overall_rate:.1f}%"
    )


main()
```
